description:
ResPdfSharp (an MIT fork of PDFsharp) is the Open Source library for creating and modifying PDF documents using .NET. It has an easy-to-use API that allows developers to generate or modify PDF files programmatically. ResPdfSharp can be used for various applications, including creating reports, invoices, and other types of documents. Out of the box it embeds fallback fonts (Arimo, Tinos, Cousine under SIL OFL 1.1) so text rendering works on any platform, including Linux and containers without system fonts.
This package does not depend on Windows and can be used on any .NET compatible platform including Linux and macOS.
See https://github.com/respellion/respdfsharp for details.
releaseNotes:
ResPdfSharp fork: this package embeds fallback fonts (Arimo, Tinos, Cousine, SIL OFL 1.1)
so font rendering works out of the box on Linux and in containers without system fonts.
See THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt in the source repository.
This is a version of PDFsharp compatible with .NET 8 and higher.
The package ‘PdfSharp’ can be used on any platform including Windows and Linux. The Target Frameworks are ‘net8.0’, ‘net9.0’, ‘net10.0’ and ‘netstandard2.0’.
The packages ‘PDFsharp-gdi’ and ‘PDFsharp-wpf’ can be used under Windows only. The Target Frameworks are ‘net8.0-windows’, ‘net9.0-windows’, ‘net10.0-windows’ and ‘net462’.
We also publish packages that contain PDFsharp plus MigraDoc.
See the project docs site for further information:
https://github.com/respellion/respdfsharp
